name: Aditya Birla Capital Ltd
about: Aditya Birla Capital Limited, the holding company for the financial services businesses of the Aditya Birla Group, is a universal financial solutions group catering to the diverse financial needs of its customers across their life stages.[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments 1) Life Insurance (44% in 9M FY25 vs 52% in FY22): [1] [2] The company’s subsidiary, Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance Ltd, is one of the leading private life insurers, offering protection solutions, children’s future solutions, wealth with protection solutions, retirement solutions, etc, through 11 Banca Tie-ups, 360+ own branches, 26,300+ bank branches, and 60,000 agents across 4,700+ cities. [3] [4]
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 112% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 3.29 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.5% over last 3 years.

announcements.text: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot 20 Nov - Postal ballot for approval of material RPTs with Grasim up to ₹4,950 crore for FY27.
Aditya Birla Capital Limited Has informed Regarding Notice Of Postal Ballot 20 Nov - Postal ballot seeks approval for ₹4,950 Cr material RPT with Grasim for FY27.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment 19 Nov - Aditya Birla Capital allots ₹400 crore NCDs on private placement, coupon 8.0668%, maturing April 30, 2036.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS 19 Nov - Aditya Birla Capital Limited has informed regarding allotment of 698366 shares.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome 18 Nov - Aditya Birla Capital held analyst and institutional investor meetings on 18 November 2026 in Mumbai.
